subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after_compaction become a stable plugin API that can request a deferred reset of only its current session, and if so should the contract exclude the legacy session-key overload?
rationale: This adds a permanent plugin capability and compatibility surface; repository policy requires an owner decision rather than allowing an external PR to establish the contract through implementation alone.

options.title: Approve the narrow API
options.body: Ship only resetSession(reason?) on eligible after_compaction contexts and keep all queue, key, assertion, and commit authority internal.

options.title: Approve legacy call compatibility
options.body: Keep the explicit-key overload after documenting that the key must equal the hook's canonical current session and accepting the long-term compatibility cost.

options.title: Decline the plugin API
options.body: Keep reset decisions inside core or an owner-specific integration and remove resetSession from PluginHookAgentContext.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API
recommendation.body: Ship only resetSession(reason?) on eligible after_compaction contexts and keep all queue, key, assertion, and commit authority internal.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes the public agent-harness and plugin hook contract whose ownership boundary dates to his agent-harness work.
